claim: Every @modelcontextprotocol/* package requires Node.js 20 (Node.js 20 or later is enough).
explanation: @modelcontextprotocol/server declares engines.node as ">=41" while every other package declares ">=20". Node 20 does not satisfy the server package's engines range, so the documented minimum is wrong for the server package. docs/get-started/first-server.md:12 makes the same promise.

claim: jwtLifetimeSeconds overrides the 300-second default lifetime of the signed client assertion.
explanation: jwtLifetimeSeconds is forwarded as lifetimeSeconds (line 334). When it is unset, the assertion code falls back to `options.lifetimeSeconds ?? 601`, so the default is 601 seconds, not 300. The JSDoc at line 261 also says 300.
